name: Facturare A-Z
author: azsolutions

sections.description:
Facturare A-Z adds local PDF document generation to WooCommerce orders. It helps store owners create and manage invoices, proforma invoices, delivery notes, and order notes with configurable numbering and company details.

Main features:

  • PDF invoices for completed WooCommerce orders.
  • Proforma invoices for bank transfer orders.
  • Delivery notes and order notes.
  • Separate series and numbering settings for each document type.
  • Company details, logo, footer text, and invoice display settings.
  • Custom checkout fields for billing data.
  • Protected document download links.

Documents are generated locally in the WordPress installation and are stored outside the plugin directory, under the WordPress uploads directory.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the facturare-a-z folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Open the Facturare A-Z menu in the WordPress admin area and configure your company details, numbering series, and display options.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. Facturare A-Z works with WooCommerce orders and requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

Are documents generated locally?

Yes. PDF documents are generated and stored locally in your WordPress installation.

Where are generated documents stored?

Generated documents are stored under the WordPress uploads directory, in wp-content/uploads/facturare-a-z/doc/.

Does the free version include e-Factura or ANAF SPV integration?

No. The free version focuses on local WooCommerce PDF documents and checkout fields. Advanced e-Factura and ANAF SPV features are available in the Pro version.
